title: In-Memory Risk Gateway
description: A two-tier pre-trade risk admission gate on the LMAX BLP: an in-process Gateway replica screens without synchronous lookup, and the single-writer BLP makes the authoritative decision and reserves exact aggregate exposure in global sequence order.

nodes.label: Client / Trade Service
nodes.description: Submits order / market-trade over REST (optional clientOrderId).

nodes.label: Risk Operator
nodes.description: Administers versioned controls via /risk/control/* (token + operator provenance).

nodes.label: Tier 1 — Gateway screening
nodes.description: GatewayReplicaStore.screen(): in-process, memory-only, no REST/DB (FR-IMRG01/06); fail-closed until ready; reject to 422 / 503 (stale).

nodes.label: Input Disruptor
nodes.description: Global input sequence carrying commands, prices, and control events (ADR-020).

nodes.label: Journaler + Replicator
nodes.description: Durable journal + NATS JetStream replication before the BLP (FR-IMRG10).

nodes.label: Tier 2 — BLP (single writer)
nodes.description: BlpRiskState.decideAndReserve / decideMarketTrade: ordered pipeline, exact aggregate exposure, check+reserve as one single-threaded op (FR-IMRG12/13).

nodes.label: Order Book / Execution
nodes.description: ACCEPTED commands enter the book and execute; the accepted order's exposure stays reserved until filled or cancelled.

nodes.label: Output Disruptor
nodes.description: The BLP's only side-effect channel (FR-IMRG27); gains order-rejected and trade-decision kinds (FR-IMRG45).

nodes.label: NATS bridges
nodes.description: Order/trade lifecycle subjects, carrying riskReason on rejection (FR-IMRG15).

nodes.label: Projector
nodes.description: Projects accepted outcomes to the MariaDB read model; reads no admission state back (FR-IMRG41).

nodes.label: MariaDB read model
nodes.description: Async projection only, never the source of admission state.

edges.label: REJECTED: journaled only, no book, no market event (FR-IMRG23)
